description: Fast TLS certificate expiry check: days remaining, issuer, validity window and an expired/expiring-soon flag, read live from a TLS handshake. The cheap monitoring primitive agents should call on a schedule before a cert lapses and an integration breaks. Use this when an agent needs to days until a certificate expires — the lightweight check. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_ssl_expiry
title: SSL Expiry Check
